rationale: Executive Order 7759 (approved Dec. 1, 1937; 2 FR 3097) only revokes Executive Orders No. 7024-B and No. 7129-A and names EO 7757 and EO 7758 as their replacements. Its single command was self-executing and was performed on approval, and the held original contains no continuing duty, deferred date, condition or duration. The own-text record OWN_TEXT:EO:7759#6061 was re-derived from the frozen original and I confirmed from the held text that every operative sentence of the order is of that self-executing kind. The one catalog observation (Revokes: EO 7024-B; EO 7129-A; See: EO 6979, EO 6980-C, EO 7757, EO 7758) describes what this order did to others and names no instrument acting on EO 7759. The status therefore rests on the order's own terms: it has no operative force on 2026-10-14.
